cohort: The study included 1191 breastfeeding females aged 15-49 years with children under 6 months, selected from the Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey (PDHS) 2018.
finding: Females who experienced physical, sexual, or emotional intimate partner violence were significantly less likely to exclusively breastfeed.
cross-section timing: Data collected for women with children under 6 months of age, with IPV experiences assessed during prenatal and post-delivery periods.
